queue_policy: Every task is a builder task with compile-first acceptance. Tasks are ordered by dependency depth, not priority; the integrator may run independent tasks in parallel. A task that cannot prove its objective must deliver an explicit-hypothesis interface plus a checked toy theorem and a BLOCKED result card.
